# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want the frontend build to be audit-clean and CI-green, so that the app ships with no known moderate+ vulnerabilities

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** the frontend dependency tree to pass `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` and the CI pipeline to be fully green
**So that** the app ships with no known exploitable vulnerabilities and every merge is gated by a passing build

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given the remediated dependency tree, when `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` was run at closure, then it exited 0. Two advisories disclosed since then broke it; tracked in #327 (`npm audit --audit-level=moderate`)
- [x] Given the frontend CI workflow, when a push triggers it, then lint, test, and build steps all pass; the audit step now fails per #327 (`npm run lint`, `npm test -- --coverage`, `npm run build`)
- [x] Given the frontend CI workflow, when `npm audit --audit-level=high` runs as a CI gate, then it exits 0. Implemented as `--audit-level=moderate` instead, strictly stricter, so a pass at moderate is also a pass at high. Rescoped to match what #131 shipped (`.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`)
- [x] Given the test suite after migration, when `npm test -- --coverage` is run, then coverage meets the 80% threshold (`npm test -- --coverage` — 93.01% statements, 82.61% branches, 90.13% functions, 93.87% lines)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 3

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Closed via #131 (commit ec9c006 on develop). CI's audit gate uses `--audit-level=moderate`, a strictly stricter check than this Story's original `--audit-level=high` wording, so that AC is satisfied by the stronger implementation rather than the literal flag.

The `uploadMedia` test hang this Story tracked as a gap under #132 is fixed: #132 closed the same day, both tests in `media.test.js` run and pass, no skips.

Post-closure regression: `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` now fails on two advisories disclosed after this Story closed, tracked in #327.
